recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future Pharmacy decision such as FHIR-53236 changes the Substance/SubstanceDefinition target model.
issue_request: FHIR-23733 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy request to revise Medication.ingredient.item[x] from actual-ingredient wording to wording that supports the substance or medication that is the basis of ingredient.strength.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to commit 2933d19faad5a9c3da59470ac68ba7222b4495d7, which changed the then-authoritative Medication spreadsheet row for Medication.ingredient.item[x]. The later source refactor migrated this into source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml.
additional_context: Later Substance/SubstanceDefinition work refined the target list without reversing FHIR-23733: FHIR-43166 added SubstanceDefinition as a Medication.ingredient.item target, and the existing FHIR-48405 reconciliation updated the prose to name SubstanceDefinition. FHIR-53236 is Triaged and unresolved, so it is not final authority for removing Substance.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The latest combined branch already has Medication active in fhir.ini and the current Medication.ingredient.item definition says it is the ingredient that ingredient.strength relates to, represented as a code or as Substance, SubstanceDefinition, or Medication.
